ABOUT
EXTRONICS
Founded in 1992, Extronics is 
the leading hazardous area IoT 
company supporting Wireless, 
RTLS, Asset Management and 
Back -up Power solutions to 
support process industry 
digitalization. 
Extronics specialises in developing and manufacturing globally certified 
hazardous area equipment that help our customers work Smart , stay Safe, and 
remain Connected  in all areas of the process industries.
